 Katie Miller mocked after blaming busy moms for GOP midterm wipeout while admitting she skipped the vote
 Rachel Dobkin in New York Wednesday 04 November 2026 08:25 EST 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover White House deputy chief of staff for policy Stephen Miller and his wife Katie ( AP ) Katie Miller , wife of White House Deputy Chief of Staff Stephen Miller , attributed Republican midterm losses to mothers being too busy raising children to vote. 
 Miller admitted she did not vote in Virginia, saying voting there would publicly expose her home address and compromise her security. 
 Her comments contradicted an earlier statement on social media, where she argued that conservatives would defeat leftists because they have more children. 
 Democrats secured control of both the House and Senate after winning major races across multiple key states. 
 President Donald Trump acknowledged the strong Democratic performance but asserted that Republicans would have won in a landslide had he been on the ballot.
